entries.text: I heard about you. You run around the Wastes killing kids! Help! Nightkin!

entries.source_text: 我听说过你，你在废土上到处杀小孩！救命啊，夜行团！

entries.text: You're mistaken, child. I'm a good man.

entries.text: 我知道这附近有个秘道，我也没找到。也许会很危险。只有墨菲斯和夜行团才准去那里。哦，我走了，赞美主教！

entries.text: Don't worry. When I'm through with him, he won't remember a thing.

entries.text: Life is tough. Learn to take it, kid, and quit whining.
entries.source_text: Life is tough. Learn to take it, kid, and quit whining.

entries.source_text: But I must! I must! Disbelief is pain!

entries.text: Please don't! He loves me! He's the only one who does.

entries.text: Okay I will . . . (sniff) Maybe Father Lasher will be more kind to me after the Master takes over the world.

entries.text: Fine, kid. What's the good news?
entries.source_text: Fine, kid. What's the good news?

entries.text: 很好，孩子，有什么新消息？
entries.source_text: 很好，孩子，有什么新消息？

entries.text: Okay. So you got any dirt for your old friend?
entries.source_text: Okay. So you got any dirt for your old friend?

entries.text: 很好，你有没有什么新料要告诉老朋友？
entries.source_text: 很好，你有没有什么新料要告诉老朋友？

entries.text: Pretty good. How about you?
entries.source_text: Pretty good. How about you?

entries.text: 不赖，你呢？
entries.source_text: 不赖，你呢？

entries.text: I dunno. Bored.
entries.source_text: I dunno. Bored.

entries.text: 我也不知道，好无聊。
entries.source_text: 我也不知道，好无聊。

entries.text: I feel lousy. Do you know how long it's been since I killed anything?
entries.source_text: I feel lousy. Do you know how long it's been since I killed anything?

entries.text: 无聊透了，你知道多久我没开杀戒了……
entries.source_text: 无聊透了，你知道多久我没开杀戒了……

entries.text: Uh, hello.
entries.source_text: Uh, hello.

entries.text: 哦，你好。
entries.source_text: 哦，你好。

entries.text: Hello kid. Can you tell me what this place is about?
entries.source_text: Hello kid. Can you tell me what this place is about?

entries.text: 你好，小鬼，这里是什么地方？
entries.source_text: 你好，小鬼，这里是什么地方？

entries.text: Hi kid. What're you doing in this joint?
entries.source_text: Hi kid. What're you doing in this joint?

entries.text: 嗨，小鬼，你在这里做啥？
entries.source_text: 嗨，小鬼，你在这里做啥？

entries.text: Hi kid. How're you doing?
entries.source_text: Hi kid. How're you doing?

entries.text: 嗨，小鬼，过的怎样？
entries.source_text: 嗨，小鬼，过的怎样？

entries.text: Out of my face, brat, or I'll turn you into a belt!
entries.source_text: Out of my face, brat, or I'll turn you into a belt!

entries.text: 滚开，小杂碎，信不信我把你打成烂肉！
entries.source_text: 滚开，小杂碎，信不信我把你打成烂肉！

entries.text: Hello? Rhyme with yellow! Funny!
entries.source_text: Hello? Rhyme with yellow! Funny!

entries.text: 你好，啊罗，你好，啊罗，有趣！
entries.source_text: 你好，啊罗，你好，啊罗，有趣！

entries.text: This is the Cathedral of the Children of the Cathedral.# I don't know why they say Cathedral twice. We worship the# Master, and we yell a lot about Peace and Unity.# It sounds kind of dumb, but the Master's real smart,# so I guess it must be okay.
entries.source_text:
This is the Cathedral of the Children of the Cathedral.
# I don't know why they say Cathedral twice. We worship the
# Master, and we yell a lot about Peace and Unity.
# It sounds kind of dumb, but the Master's real smart,
# so I guess it must be okay.

entries.text: 这里是大教堂，大教堂。我也不知道为什么要说两遍大教堂。我们信仰主教大人，呼唤和平和同一。看起来有点老调，但主教真的很英明，所以我觉得挺好。
entries.source_text: 这里是大教堂，大教堂。我也不知道为什么要说两遍大教堂。我们信仰主教大人，呼唤和平和同一。看起来有点老调，但主教真的很英明，所以我觉得挺好。

entries.text: Tell me more about the Master.
entries.source_text: Tell me more about the Master.

entries.text: 说说你们的主教。
entries.source_text: 说说你们的主教。

entries.text: Sounds dumb to me, too. What are you doing here?
entries.source_text: Sounds dumb to me, too. What are you doing here?

entries.text: 我也觉得老土，你在这里做什么？
entries.source_text: 我也觉得老土，你在这里做什么？

entries.text: Don't talk about your elders that way, okay?
entries.source_text: Don't talk about your elders that way, okay?

entries.text: 别这样随便谈论你的前辈，知道吗？
entries.source_text: 别这样随便谈论你的前辈，知道吗？

entries.text: What kind of a brainwashed little fool are you? You're going to grow up to be one of these zombies! I should kill you now!
entries.source_text: What kind of a brainwashed little fool are you? You're going to grow up to be one of these zombies! I should kill you now!

entries.text: 你是个被洗脑的小笨蛋，你长大后会变僵尸的！杀了你算了。
entries.source_text: 你是个被洗脑的小笨蛋，你长大后会变僵尸的！杀了你算了。

entries.text: I give out flowers. Every petal is peace, and the stem is unity. Or are the petals unity and the stem peace? Oh no, I don't remember! Do you want one?
entries.source_text: I give out flowers. Every petal is peace, and the stem is unity. Or are the petals unity and the stem peace? Oh no, I don't remember! Do you want one?

entries.text: 我送花，每片花瓣象征和平，花茎象征同一。不对……花茎象征和平，花瓣象征同一？哎呀，不记得了，你要花吗？
entries.source_text: 我送花，每片花瓣象征和平，花茎象征同一。不对……花茎象征和平，花瓣象征同一？哎呀，不记得了，你要花吗？

entries.text: I'll take one if you tell me what's going on around here.
entries.source_text: I'll take one if you tell me what's going on around here.

entries.text: 如果你给我说说这里的事情，我就要一朵。
entries.source_text: 如果你给我说说这里的事情，我就要一朵。

entries.text: Sure.
entries.source_text: Sure.

entries.text: 好啊。
entries.source_text: 好啊。

entries.text: No, thanks.
entries.source_text: No, thanks.

entries.text: 不用，谢谢。
entries.source_text: 不用，谢谢。

entries.text: Screw peace. Screw unity. And get that flower out of my face!
entries.source_text: Screw peace. Screw unity. And get that flower out of my face!

entries.text: 狗屁和平，狗屁同一，把你的猪草从我脸上拿走！
entries.source_text: 狗屁和平，狗屁同一，把你的猪草从我脸上拿走！

entries.text: Father Lasher says I shouldn't talk to strangers . . . until we have Unity, of course; then nobody'll be a stranger. Bye!
entries.source_text: Father Lasher says I shouldn't talk to strangers . . . until we have Unity, of course; then nobody'll be a stranger. Bye!

entries.text: 拉舍尔神父说我不能与陌生人讲话……除非我们实现同一了。那时候谁都不是外人了，再见。
entries.source_text: 拉舍尔神父说我不能与陌生人讲话……除非我们实现同一了。那时候谁都不是外人了，再见。

entries.text: I'm okay. At least until Father Lasher's next lesson.
entries.source_text: I'm okay. At least until Father Lasher's next lesson.

entries.text: 还好，起码在拉舍尔下次给我上课之前还算好。
entries.source_text: 还好，起码在拉舍尔下次给我上课之前还算好。

entries.text: Maybe if you studied harder, the lessons wouldn't be so bad.
entries.source_text: Maybe if you studied harder, the lessons wouldn't be so bad.

entries.text: 你用点功啊，下次上课就没那么难熬了。
entries.source_text: 你用点功啊，下次上课就没那么难熬了。

entries.text: Tell me more about Father Lasher.
entries.source_text: Tell me more about Father Lasher.

entries.text: 说说这位拉舍尔神父。
entries.source_text: 说说这位拉舍尔神父。

entries.text: What kind of lesson?
entries.source_text: What kind of lesson?

entries.text: 什么样的课？
entries.source_text: 什么样的课？

entries.text: Stop whining, you little brat, and be grateful that somebody's bothering to teach you!
entries.source_text: Stop whining, you little brat, and be grateful that somebody's bothering to teach you!

entries.text: 别哭哭啼啼的，小鬼，你该为有人这样费心给你上课而感激！
entries.source_text: 别哭哭啼啼的，小鬼，你该为有人这样费心给你上课而感激！

entries.text: I never do good enough! Never!
entries.source_text: I never do good enough! Never!

entries.text: 我怎么用功都不够好！永远不够好！
entries.source_text: 我怎么用功都不够好！永远不够好！

entries.text: 【done】
entries.source_text: 【done】

entries.text: 【完成】
entries.source_text: 【完成】
